name: subscription-manager
description: 订阅管理系统 - 支持 Cloudflare Pages Functions / Workers + KV + D1（零第三方运行时路由依赖）

scripts.deploy:pages:safe: npm run setup:pages && npm run build:pages && npm run deploy:pages
scripts.dev:pages: npx wrangler pages dev public --config wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:worker:safe: npm run setup:worker && npm run deploy:worker
scripts.setup:local-d1: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply subscription-manager-dev --local --config wrangler.worker.dev.toml
